name: Services
description: IT, consulting, marketing, legal, accounting, security and staffing vendors. Service vendors carry engagement and data-protection risk rather than goods risk, so the asks are contractual rather than physical.

fields.label: Services provided
fields.why: We check this against your registered business activity and the category you selected.

fields.label: Engagement model
fields.why: Determines which contract template and approval threshold applies.

fields.label: Will you access our systems or personal data?
fields.why: Any access to personal data triggers a data-processing agreement before work starts.

documents.label: Professional indemnity insurance
documents.why: Fixed-price and managed engagements carry delivery risk we need covered.
documents.expects: A professional indemnity insurance certificate naming the business

documents.label: Data processing agreement
documents.why: Required by data-protection law before you can process personal data on our behalf.
documents.expects: A signed data processing agreement or equivalent data-protection addendum

documents.label: ISO / security certification
documents.why: Not required, but it shortens our security review considerably.
documents.expects: An ISO 27001, SOC 2 or equivalent certificate naming the business
